headline: JJ Spaun wins the BMW PGA. 271, 17 under. Elvira double-bogeys 18.
whyCareReason: The DP World Tour flagship has a winner. AP: Spaun 271, 17 under. Elvira, McIlroy, Rai and Scott share 273. Heart: Elvira double bogey on 18.
teaser: FINAL: JJ Spaun 271 (-17). AP: Elvira, McIlroy, Rai, Scott 273. Celli 274. Gerard 278.
story:
Why this one matters: majors and the FedEx Cup are finished. The European flagship now has a name. AP and the DP World Tour print JJ Spaun at 17 under.

AP via WTOP: Spaun 70-66-68-67, 271. Manuel Elvira 69-66-68-70, Rory McIlroy 69-67-69-68, Aaron Rai 66-69-72-66 and Adam Scott 67-67-71-68, all 273. Filippo Celli 68-66-69-71, 274. Ryan Gerard, the 36-hole leader, 67-65-75-71, 278.

Heart: Spaun a final-round 67 with six birdies after an early bogey. Elvira needed a birdie on 18 to win, found a fairway bunker, then chipped into a bunker and made a double bogey. FOX: Spaun -17, four players T2 at -15. Presidents Cup is still 24-27 September at Medinah.
stakes: A flagship trophy is in the book. The next DP World Tour date is the FedEx Open de France.
rivalryAngle: A US Open champion who was left off the Presidents Cup team against a Sunday board that still included McIlroy, Elvira, Rai and Scott.
